argument.statement: A radical solution to the perennial instability of Central Europe was defeated.

book.rationale: The book centers on the historical context of the Oder-Neisse Line and the policies of General Sikorski during World War II, which are best categorized under World History with a focus on military and political aspects.
book.summary: The author explores a variety of questions related to General Sikorski's policies, such as his effort to maintain an independent Polish Arms' in the Soviet Union. Drawing on extensive British, American, and Polish archives, her work describes the defeat of a radical solution to the perennial instability of Central Europe. Originally published in 1983.
